effective_or_revised: Date of Last Revision 06/2307/24 (redline merged: 06/23 and 07/24); annual review 07/24
criteria_location: Policy/Criteria p.1: I.A, I.B (with 11 numbered contraindications and a warfarin note), II.
procedures_covered: Percutaneous LAA occlusion with Watchman, Watchman FLX, Amplatzer Amulet (33340)
Other devices: research does not support

k_of_n.quote: Contraindications or unacceptable high risk of bleeding from long-term oral anticoagulants, including, but not limited to: 1. Thrombocytopenia ... 11. Inability to obtain regular international normalized ratios.

and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Open list: the 11 items are examples, so any other contraindication counts; also not stated that any one suffices.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: There is an increased risk for stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc scores, and long-term anticoagulation therapy is recommended;
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No cutoff; 'or' lets either score qualify.
Non-valvular is a criterion in the lead-in, but no definition is given.

requirement_kinds.quote: increased risk for stroke and systemic embolism based on CHADS2 or CHA2DS2-VASc scores
Thrombocytopenia or known coagulation defect associated with bleeding
Recurrent bleeding, including gastrointestinal, genitourinary, respiratory
Prior severe bleeding, including intracranial hemorrhage
Combined use of dual antiplatelet and anticoagulant therapy
Poor compliance or intolerance with anticoagulant therapy
High risk of the patient falling or prior falls resulting in injury
Inability to obtain regular international normalized ratios

time_windows.quote: Warfarin may be required for at least six weeks after implantation of the Watchman or Watchman FLX device.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: 33340 only; ICD-10 table removed per revision log.

external_dependencies.quote: Federal Drug Administration (FDA) approved percutaneous devices (i.e., WATCHMAN, WATCHMAN FLX, and Amplatzer Amulet)
See Important Reminder at the end of this policy for important regulatory and legal information.

extraction_hazards: Redline merged year digits in header ('06/2307/24', '20222023')
Numbered sub-list I.B.1-11 under a colon, indistinct from sentence flow
Coding table and revision log in two-column table
Background includes guideline recommendations with numbers (CHA2DS2-VASc > 2) that are not criteria
interesting_structures: Contraindication menu of 11 with open 'including, but not limited to'
Explicit anticoagulation-contraindication requirement (unlike FL's score-based approach)

fit_to_tree.why: Clean all-of with a 1-of-11 any-block, but the any-block is open-ended and each item is vague.
